name: zoco-ai
description: Zoco AI — self-hosted voice calling platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix realtime
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix realtime"
